Geometry on the mid-flank is vertically elongated, transitioning to smaller, more equant shapes towards the hindquarters. Pixel gradients at edges are moderately defined but softened by image resolution.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored, narrow pathways forming a tessellated grid. Topology is characterized by frequent tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes. The thickness of the corridors is relatively uniform across the visible flank, showing high connectivity.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck and shoulder exhibits a fine-grained, low-amplitude serrated silhouette. The frequency of the jagged peaks is high and regular against the background luminance.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: No abrupt structural discontinuities or missing segments are visible within the observed length of the mane.
